card.architecture: MiniMax-H3-Image single-stream DiT (pruned 20B, int8 ConvRot; Qwen3-VL 32B vision-language encoder; reference latents through the 24-channel VAE; 6-step PDD distilled, no CFG)
card.summary: The same MiniMax-H3-Image checkpoint edits a picture from an instruction and composes up to 15 additional reference pictures into it (16 in total), preserving identity, products and layout.
use_cases: subject and identity preservation into a new scene
card.commercial_use: restricted (MiniMax H3 Image Community License: separate authorization required above 1M USD annual revenue or for hosted services)
card.pick_when: You need a high-resolution editor that takes many references at once and keeps subjects intact.

prompt.guidance: Refer to every input as <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, ... The source is <Picture 1>; attachments follow in order. Name preserved subjects explicitly.
prompt.example: Replace the vintage yellow taxi in <Picture 1> with the pastel-blue scooter from <Picture 2>; keep the street, the lighting and the camera angle unchanged.
prompt.overview: Picture 1 is the edit target and sets the canvas; up to 15 attachments become Pictures 2-16. The vision-language encoder reads every picture and the VAE anchors each as a reference latent.
prompt.instructions: Say what must stay unchanged, then the change. Address each input by its tag: <Picture 1> for the source, <Picture 2> onward for the attachments in upload order. To carry a subject into the result, bind it explicitly (e.g. 'the woman in <Picture 2> is <Subject 1>') and refer to that subject afterwards. Describe the desired result in detail; short instructions underuse the model. Sampling is fixed: 6 steps, CFG 1.
do: Refer to every input as <Picture N>
State what to preserve before what to change
dont: Use vague references like 'the other image'
Expect a negative prompt to act (no CFG)
prompt.negative_guidance: Not supported: the model is distilled to CFG 1.

speed.note: 6 steps; each reference adds vision and latent tokens. Not yet benchmarked on this box.

ui_help.note: Upload the picture to edit, then optional references. Call them <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, etc. in the instruction.
ui_help.good_for: multi-reference composition and identity-safe edits at high resolution

edit_use_cases: instruction editing and multi-reference composition with up to 16 pictures in total

reference.hint: The source is <Picture 1>; attachments are <Picture 2> through <Picture 16>. Name them explicitly in the instruction.
